title: AltBeta - Fix
description: This is a fixed version of the AltBeta texturepack by Domovishche6986
body:
This is a fixed version of the **AltBeta** pack by **Domovishche6986**. It fixes a texture issue with the cow and also fixes the texture of the leather armor cap.

The author of the original version of this texture pack is [Domovishche6986](https://modrinth.com/user/Domovishche6986) - [AltBeta](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/altbeta/)
